name: Nascor Descent
storyline: After a tragic death, you awaken in a mysterious tower that is now your purgatory. To return to life, you must find an exit in its vast labyrinth. The tower and its five realms are dangerous places filled with terrifying abominations, deadly traps, and many ways to break your mind.You will need to face and defeat them all if you want to taste life again. You can become one of four Fallen Ones, each with different specialties, knowledge, and morality. Your character will affect many things, from the way you fight to how other people and monsters will treat you.Will you be their savior or their ruin? At the end of the depths, you will meet the most dangerous foes. They will do whatever they can to stop you. They will be your final challenge on your path to salvation.However, who knows? Maybe your decisions leading up to these encounters will also affect your duels. There are still many floors and layers of the tower between you and your goal, but don't lose hope, because that's the last thing you have left, Fallen One...
summary: Nascor Descent is a first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler with a grim atmosphere, fast-paced combat, and meaningful choices that will affect both the story and your gameplay.
